title: What the Zscaler Acceptable Use Policy and Product Output Disclaimer say about permitted use, AI Features and Outputs

aup-scope.statement: The Acceptable Use Policy covers Zscaler's and its affiliates' products, platforms, professional, support and consulting services and any other services provided by or on behalf of Zscaler, including Outputs, deliverables and recommendations generated in connection with them; it is incorporated into, and subject to, the terms of the customer's Agreement, binds on accessing any Offering, and Zscaler may modify it at any time.

quotes: outlines acceptable uses of Zscaler’s and its affiliates’ products, platforms, professional services, support services, consulting services, and any other services provided by or on behalf of Zscaler (collectively, "Offerings")
including any Outputs (as defined in the Product Output Disclaimer), deliverables, or recommendations generated in connection with such Offerings
By accessing any Offerings, you agree to this Policy. This Policy is incorporated into, and subject to, the terms of your Agreement. We reserve the right to modify this Policy at any time.

aup-conduct-restrictions.statement: Section 1 of the AUP bars posting, transmitting or storing libelous, obscene, threatening, defamatory, infringing or unlawful content; reproducing rights-held material without permission; spam; harvesting email addresses or identifiers without consent; falsifying or removing message headers; and impersonation, forgery or phishing.

quotes: 1.1. Posting, transmitting, or storing content that is libelous, obscene, threatening, defamatory, or that infringes any intellectual property rights or violates any applicable law;
1.2. Reproducing, distributing, or creating derivative works from material obtained through the Offerings without required permissions from the rights holder;
1.3. Sending unsolicited bulk messages ("Spam"), or transmitting large volumes of duplicative, empty, or oversized messages that disrupt any service;
1.4. Harvesting email addresses, screen names, or other identifiers without prior consent, including through spidering or spyware;
1.5. Falsifying or removing message headers; or
1.6. Impersonating any person or entity, forging signatures, falsifying sender addresses, or engaging in phishing or similar fraudulent activity.

aup-technical-restrictions.statement: Section 2 of the AUP prohibits accessing systems or data without the owner's consent, circumventing security, using or distributing tools such as password guessing programs, keystroke loggers, packet sniffers or Trojan Horse programs, unauthorized port scanning, and copying, distributing, sublicensing or making unauthorized modifications to Zscaler Offerings.

quotes: You may not access any computer, system, network, software, or data without the owner's consent, or attempt to breach or circumvent the security of any host, network, or account.

You may not use or distribute security-compromising tools such as password guessing programs, keystroke loggers, packet sniffers, or Trojan Horse programs. Unauthorized port scanning is strictly prohibited.
You may not copy, distribute, sublicense, or make unauthorized modifications to any Zscaler Offerings.

aup-interference.statement: The AUP bars interfering with any entity's use of the Offerings, including by transmitting malicious code or generating disruptive traffic levels, and degrading the Offerings or Zscaler infrastructure through denial of service attacks, network flooding or service overloading.

quotes: You may not interfere with any entity's use of the Offerings, including by transmitting malicious code or generating disruptive traffic levels.
You may not degrade the performance of the Offerings or any Zscaler infrastructure through denial of service attacks, network flooding, service overloading, or any similar means.

aup-ai-features-scope.statement: AUP section 3 governs Zscaler functionality powered by AI or machine learning (AI Features), including chatbots, policy recommendations, generative outputs, AI-assisted security assessments and AI red teaming tools such as the SPLX platform, whether embedded in products or delivered through services; new or updated AI Features are subject to the Policy on release without separate notice or consent.

quotes: including chatbots, policy recommendations, generative outputs, AI-assisted security assessments, AI red teaming tools (such as the SPLX platform)
functionality powered by or incorporating artificial intelligence or machine learning (“AI Features”)
Zscaler may introduce new or updated AI Features from time to time.
whether embedded in Zscaler products, delivered through professional services, tech support, threat hunting, consulting, or otherwise made available by Zscaler personnel or contractors
Your use of such AI Features is automatically subject to this Policy upon its release, without the need for separate notice or consent.

aup-ai-outputs-verify.statement: The AUP says AI Features' outputs may be incomplete, inaccurate or inappropriate, are for general informational purposes only, must not be the sole basis for any decision including consequential decisions about employment, health or safety, and are the customer's sole responsibility to verify before acting.

quotes: their outputs may be incomplete, inaccurate, or inappropriate and should not be relied upon without independent verification
You are solely responsible for evaluating and verifying all AI-generated outputs before taking any action on them.

Outputs are for general informational purposes only and should not be relied upon as the sole basis for any decision or action, including consequential decisions such as those impacting a person’s employment status, health, or safety.

aup-ai-prohibited-uses.statement: The AUP prohibits using AI Features to violate law, override safety or privacy filters, generate harmful, sexually explicit, infringing or deceptive content, exploit them for malicious purposes, create training data for other AI systems without Zscaler's permission, or reverse engineer them or extract model weights; they are also not to be treated as professional advice.

quotes: Do not violate any applicable law
Any attempts to exploit AI Features for malicious purposes like system interference, hacking or distributing malware are not allowed.
Do not override safety or privacy filters, controls, or mechanisms.

(a) harms or threatens harm to any individual; (b) is sexually explicit or exploitative; (c) violates or infringes the rights of others; or (d) is intentionally or reasonably foreseeably misleading or deceptive.
using AI Features for creating training data for other AI systems without Zscaler’s permission is not allowed
You may not reverse engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract the model weights, algorithms, or underlying architecture of any AI Features
AI Features do not provide, and should not be treated as, medical, legal, financial, or any other kind of professional advisory services.

aup-high-risk-activity.statement: The AUP states AI Features are not designed or intended for purposes requiring fail-safe performance (High Risk Activity), such as stock trading, financial transaction processing, public transit, nuclear facilities, electrical grid management, aircraft navigation or communication, air traffic control, life support machines or weapons systems, and no Offering or AI Feature may be used as a safety component for one.

quotes: not designed nor intended for any purpose requiring fail-safe performance, including stock trading, financial transaction processing, public transit systems, operation of nuclear facilities
electrical grid management, aircraft navigation or communication systems, air traffic control, life support machines, or weapons systems
Do not use any Offering or any of its AI Features as a safety component for any High Risk Activity.

aup-sensitive-information.statement: The AUP says users should not share any personal or sensitive information, Zscaler does not need or require sensitive personal information to provide AI Features, users should not input it, the customer is solely responsible for its own policies on what may be submitted, and Zscaler is not liable for loss, disclosure or misuse of sensitive or confidential information submitted in violation of the customer's policies or applicable law.

quotes: For your privacy and security, do not share any personal or sensitive information.
Zscaler does not need or require sensitive personal information to provide AI Features.
You and your users should not upload or input sensitive personal information into AI Features.
You are solely responsible for having appropriate internal policies regarding what types of information may and may not be submitted to AI Features.

Zscaler shall not be liable for any loss, disclosure, or misuse of sensitive or confidential information that you or your users submit to AI Features in violation of your own policies or applicable law.

aup-monitor-terminate.statement: Zscaler reserves the right to monitor use of the Offerings and to suspend or terminate access for a violation of the AUP.

quotes: Zscaler reserves the right to monitor use of the Offerings and the right to suspend or terminate your access due to violation of this Policy.

output-disclaimer-as-is.statement: The Product Output Disclaimer defines Outputs as information such as risk scores, vulnerability assessments, recommendations, chatbot responses, generated content, reports or deliverables presented by Zscaler Offerings or AI Features; Zscaler disclaims any warranty or representation for them, disclaims all liability for actions taken or not taken based on them, and provides them on an "as is" basis only.

quotes: Zscaler expressly disclaims any warranty or representation with respect to any information

any information, including risk scores, vulnerability assessments, recommendations, chatbot responses, generated content, reports, or deliverables presented by Zscaler Offerings or AI Features (collectively, "Outputs")
All liability with respect to actions taken or not taken based on the Outputs is hereby disclaimed. The Outputs are provided on an "as is" basis only.

output-disclaimer-access-control.statement: The disclaimer states Outputs may expose restricted information such as employee or financial data, or reveal latent security vulnerabilities in the customer's IT environment that a malicious insider could exploit, and makes the customer solely responsible for access controls and for limiting access to authorized personnel.

quotes: Outputs may expose information such as employee or financial data that you restrict to specific departments or roles.
you are solely responsible for implementing appropriate access controls and usage policies relating to such Offerings and AI Features
Offerings may produce Outputs that reveal latent security vulnerabilities within your information technology environment
such information could be exploited by a malicious insider who was given access to such information
You are solely responsible for ensuring only the authorized personnel have access to Outputs that may contain such restricted and/or sensitive security vulnerability information.

aup-version-and-references.title: Which version or effective date of the AUP the captured page is, and what the referenced agreement says
aup-version-and-references.detail: The captured Acceptable Use Policy shows no effective date or version and references the End User Subscription Agreement, which is not captured. High Risk Activity is defined only for AI Features in section 3.3.4, and the Product Output Disclaimer has no clause numbers.
